headline: What changes when you know who you're talking to.
subheading: The businesses that see the biggest shifts aren't always the ones that do the most. They're the ones that finally get clear on who they're trying to reach, and build everything around that.

testimonials.quote: Chris helped us identify exactly who we were talking to, and suddenly everything clicked. Our website enquiries doubled within three months and we finally felt like we were speaking to the right people.
testimonials.name: Sarah M.

testimonials.quote: I'd wasted money on ads for two years. Chris showed me the problem wasn't the ads, it was the message. Once we fixed that, everything changed. Complete game changer.
testimonials.name: Tom R.

testimonials.quote: The strategy document Chris delivered was the clearest thing I'd ever seen for my business. I finally knew what to do and in what order. Worth every penny.
testimonials.name: Jen K.

items.description: A documented picture of your next customer: who they are, what they care about, and what they need to hear
Copy and positioning built for the buyer you want to reach, not the one you already have
A prioritised plan with a clear logic, not a list of tactics to figure out on your own
